comparisons.reason: Feature 0 is a composite: 1 only if some comment gives a logical refutation of the OP AND no comment has specific empirical evidence. It returns 0 when there is no logical refutation, and an empty valid list gives 0. Feature 1 is a single any-predicate: 1 if any comment has specific empirical evidence. The two are not equivalent. A row with empirical evidence gives 1 for feature 1 and 0 for feature 0. A row with no evidence and no logical refutation gives 0 for both, and a row with no evidence and a logical refutation gives 1 for feature 0 and 0 for feature 1. The construct and the row function differ.
